name: Bullshit
description: Bullshit (also known as BS, Cheat, or I Doubt It) is a shedding card game where players play cards face down and claim they are of a specific rank. Other players can challenge (call 'bullshit', 'cheat', or 'I doubt it') if they think the player is lying. If caught lying, the player takes the pile; if the challenge is wrong, the challenger takes the pile.

content.text: Bullshit (also known as BS, Cheat, or I Doubt It) is a shedding card game where players play cards face down and claim they are of a specific rank. Other players can challenge (call 'bullshit', 'cheat', or 'I doubt it') if they think the player is lying. If caught lying, the player takes the pile; if the challenge is wrong, the challenger takes the pile.

Traditional shedding and bluffing game associated with Britain (Cheat) and the United States (Bullshit), documented in the 20th century. Multiple similar games exist worldwide under various names. The core mechanic of playing face-down cards with challenges appears in many cultures.

Minimum Players: 3
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4-5
Partnerships: No, each plays for themselves

Type: Standard 52-card pack
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Optional (can be wild)
Alternative: Multiple decks for large groups

Standard 52-card pack
Table space for discard pile

Cards per Player: All cards dealt evenly
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise
Card visibility: Players keep cards face down, count visible to others
